paper_title: ChatGPT tells 20 versions of its prototypical story, with a short note on method, Version 3
paper_main_claim: ChatGPT has a 'prototypical story' revealing structure of underlying model
paper_method: Prompted ChatGPT with single word 'story' 20x: 10 in one session, 10 in separate sessions
paper_key_result: Fairy-tale exploration/return story recurs; 'Elara' protagonist 2/10 single session vs 5/10 separate sessions
paper_interpretation: Prototypical story is abstraction over training corpus; blackbox study as valid as mechanistic interpretability
student_takeaway: Replicated with Llama/DeepSeek models; scale and training corpus affect prototype completeness and coherence
student_method: Scored 20+ generated stories on 8-element prototype rubric (Home, Departure, Magical World, Helpers, Challenge, Growth, Return, Community Benefit)
student_key_finding: Single-session prompts yield more coherent/varied output; larger models (Llama-3.3-70B, DeepSeek) more coherent than Llama-3.1-8B; DeepSeek has a different default story
